info.name: Brightcove Analytics API Reference Access Tokens Live Jobs API

params.name: start_token
params.description: Next token from previous page; do not specify when fetching first page

params.name: page_size
params.description: Max number of items to return in one request (1-1000, default is 10)

params.name: sort
params.description: Attribute to sort jobs by (`created_at` | `modified_at`, default is `created_at`)

params.name: sort_dir
params.description: Sort direction (default is asc):`asc` - ascending; `desc` - descending

params.name: user_id
params.description: Filter results by one or more user IDs

params.name: account_id
params.description: Filter results by particular account, or specify ‘*’ to search all accounts.  Default value is account API key belongs to

params.name: created_at
params.description: Filter results by Unix time of job creation (in milliseconds)

params.name: modified_at
params.description: Filter results by Unix time of job last modified (in milliseconds)

params.name: ad_insertion
params.description: Filter results by is SSAI enabled

params.name: static
params.description: Filter results by has static endpoint

params.name: state
params.description: Filter results by one or more job states

params.name: ssai_state
params.description: Filter results by one or more SSAI states

params.name: region
params.description: Filter results by one or more regions

items.docs: Cancel a live stream. When a live job is cancelled, it is ended, and any unprocessed VOD jobs associated with the live job will **not** be processed.

params.name: job_id
params.description: Live job ID

items.docs: Stop a live job. When a live job is stopped (as opposed to cancelled), the live stream will stop, but any VOD jobs associated with the live job **will** continue to process. **Warning: do *NOT* use this request to stop an SEP job - that is not supported and will put the SEP job into a state where it cannot be deactivated and must be cancelled. Use [Deactivate SEP Job](##operation/DeactivateSepStream) instead.**
